tasks.gr9-careers-career-choices-t4: Topic: Careers and Career Choices. Cover subject choices, aptitudes, career fields, world of work, and lifelong learning. Ask learners to match abilities to careers, research career fields, evaluate subject choices, explore job shadowing, or develop career interest portfolios.
tasks.gr9-study-methods-exam-readiness-t4: Topic: Study Methods and Exam Readiness. Cover revision schedules, exam technique, time management, and stress control. Ask learners to create revision schedules, practise exam strategies, develop time management plans, implement stress management techniques, or reflect on exam preparation.
tasks.gr9-responsible-future-planning-t4: Topic: Responsible Future Planning. Cover decision-making, goal review, resilience, support networks, and motivation. Ask learners to review their annual goals, analyse their progress, develop resilience strategies, map their support networks, or create action plans for Grade 10.
tasks.gr9-physical-education-task-4-t4: Topic: Physical Education Task — Term 4. Cover fitness review, games application, active lifestyles, and personal targets. Ask learners to complete year-end fitness assessments, demonstrate sport applications, set fitness goals for next year, maintain participation records, or evaluate lifelong activity plans.
tasks.gr9-study-career-funding-t4: Topic: Study and career funding (Grade 9 Life Orientation, Term 4). Cover costs of study, bursaries, loans and learnerships, funding providers (NSFAS, SETAs, companies, banks, universities and colleges), how to apply, and lifelong learning goals. No income thresholds. Ask the learner directly (you), never about learners or CAPS.
tasks.gr9-religions-and-peace-t4: Topic: Religions and peace (Grade 9 Life Orientation, Term 4). Describe, never rank, how followers of Christianity, Islam, Judaism, Hinduism, Buddhism and African traditional beliefs contribute to peace (use 'many followers believe'), freedom of religion in the Constitution, and inter-faith cooperation. Ask the learner directly (you), never about learners or CAPS.
tasks.gr9-sport-ethics-t4: Topic: Sport ethics (Grade 9 Life Orientation, Term 4). Cover fair play, honesty, respect for rules, opponents and officials, cheating and doping, inclusion and good sportsmanship in all physical activities. Ask the learner directly (you), never about learners or CAPS.
tasks.gr9-challenging-situations-t4: Topic: Challenging situations: grief, loss, trauma and depression (Grade 9 Life Orientation, Term 4). Cover natural feelings in hard times, signs of depression versus ordinary sadness, healthy and counterproductive coping (alcohol and drugs), problem-solving, and getting help (trusted adult, teacher, school counsellor, clinic, Childline 116). Never describe self-harm methods. Ask the learner directly (you), never about learners or CAPS.
